issue.title: Add a --shout option to greet and document it in docs/
issue.problem: bin/greet.js has no --shout option. It picks the first argument that does not start with '--' as the name and silently ignores every '--' flag, so `node bin/greet.js --shout Ada` prints `Hello, Ada!` exactly like the plain call. src/greet.js only exports `greeting(name)` returning `Hello, ${name}!`. docs/index.md, which .github/workflows/pages.yml publishes to https://o.github.io/greet-cli/ on every push to main, documents only `node bin/greet.js <name>` and does not mention --shout.
issue.reason: Support wants a louder greeting for the lobby screen and wants a docs page they can point people to. Right now the flag is accepted but does nothing, so users get no error and no shouted greeting.
issue.outcome: `greet --shout <name>` prints the greeting in upper case. Without the flag the output is unchanged. docs/index.md documents --shout, so the existing pages workflow puts it on the published site once the PR merges.
expect: `node bin/greet.js --shout Ada` exits 0 and prints exactly `HELLO, ADA!` followed by a newline on stdout
`node bin/greet.js Ada --shout` (flag after the name) also exits 0 and prints exactly `HELLO, ADA!` followed by a newline
`node bin/greet.js Ada` without the flag still prints exactly `Hello, Ada!` followed by a newline
`node bin/greet.js --shout` with no name exits with status 2 and writes the usage message to stderr, as the plain no-name call does
docs/index.md documents the --shout option, showing its usage and that it prints the greeting in upper case (e.g. `HELLO, <NAME>!`)
The test suite has at least one test that runs bin/greet.js with --shout and asserts the upper-case output, and `npm test` passes

text:
I wrote the issue for adding `--shout` to `greet`, and the harness accepted it. It now goes to the independent challenger; I changed nothing in the repository.

**What the repository has now:** `bin/greet.js` ignores every `--` flag. So `node bin/greet.js --shout Ada` already runs and prints `Hello, Ada!`, with no error and no change. `docs/index.md` documents only `node bin/greet.js <name>`. The existing pages workflow publishes the `docs/` folder to the docs site on every push to main. The tests pass today.

**What the issue requires:**
- `--shout` prints the whole greeting in upper case (`HELLO, ADA!`), whether the flag comes before or after the name.
- Without the flag, the output stays `Hello, Ada!`.
- `--shout` with no name still exits with status 2 and prints the usage message.
- `docs/index.md` documents `--shout`.
- At least one test runs the command with `--shout` and checks the upper-case output, and `npm test` passes.

**The docs-site part:** the request asked for the option to appear on the published docs site. That can only be seen after merge, so the issue checks `docs/index.md` in the pull request instead. Confirming the live site is listed as out of scope.

**Defaults I chose, recorded as assumptions:**
- "Louder" means the whole greeting in upper case, punctuation kept.
- The builder chooses where in the code the change goes.
- The README doesn't need to change, since it only links to the docs site.
